decision: USER 2026-10-03: the whole 4,096-element all-reduce vector as ONE stream; DEPTH by Little's law

diagnosis.why_split: Program segmentation only. tools/hdc_qwen_fullshape_program*.py split_collectives (AR_WORDS default 128) cuts each 256-word all-reduce into two TP descriptors because the 8-bit descriptor count cannot hold 256; segment B is a lone END word. The sequencer runs one descriptor at a time (S_COLL waits for the last reduced word before S_DESC), so each segment pays the full link fill and drain. Not SU width, not FIFO DEPTH (1,024 >= 256), not credits (0 link stalls), no hub step.
diagnosis.already_in_source: rtl/rom/ot_qwen_tp_seq_w12.sv ENABLE_AR256 (default 0) decodes count 0 as 256 for an all-reduce; generator AR_WORDS=256 (env QWEN_O4_AR_WORDS) emits it; tools/qwen_rom_rt_token_w12.py --enable-ar256. Never measured on the runtime.
diagnosis.trace_l0: itrace a17a3c79: coll 1280-1408 resume 1770; coll 1777-1905 resume 2267 (987 per all-reduce, 2 per layer)

littles_law_depth.note: a 256-word vector never has more than 256 words outstanding, so DEPTH 256 streams at link rate with 0 stalls (measured); 128 stalls 552 cycles

16.note: as-built q16d16 engine (model QWEN_EXCHANGE_AS_BUILT): flop FIFO; at LAT 339 it is credit-limited (16 words per round trip)

area_delta.chosen: DEPTH 256, 3 remote-source FIFOs of 256 x 546 b in 3 x ot_sram_1r1w_256x256 macros each: 0.064 mm2/die
area_delta.gate_0p5mm2: PASS (0.064 mm2 macro; 0.37 mm2 even as flops)
area_delta.caveat: a macro FIFO needs a registered head (prefetch) the flop-array RTL does not have; SS clk-q of the 256x256 macro is 511 ps against the 833 ps period. Not implemented here: the runtime and bench use the existing flop-array RTL with DEPTH as a parameter.

link_and_routing: Same bytes (256 x 64 B data + 34-bit tag per destination per all-reduce); peak 1 record/cycle/link in both cases, the idle fill/drain gap is removed. No new wires; the link model's BPC 3,600 B/cycle is not binding.
exactness: Per-lane rank-ordered fold unchanged (lane-wise; the split only partitioned words). Golden tools/hdc_golden.fold / decode_token_tp unchanged.
